title: Reassign several appointments to another doctor
summary: Bulk operations: select appointments by date, doctor or room and move them to another doctor.

inputs.period: Today, This week or This month

steps.title: Menu → Appointments
steps.details: The calendar shows appointments by room and doctor.

steps.title: Bulk operations
steps.details: The calendar switches to selection mode.

steps.title: Date range
steps.details: Today, this week or this month.

steps.title: Doctors
steps.details: Check which doctors to take the appointments from: they get selected on their own.

steps.title: Rooms
steps.details: Optional: only the appointments on those calendars. You can also check appointments one by one on the calendar.

steps.title: Reassign doctor
steps.details: Enabled when there are selected appointments.
